title: Taxonium
description: DEMO ONLY, GPL-3.0, not for shipping. Taxonium is a WebGL (deck.gl) viewer app for very large trees, packaged as one React 19 component with a singleton worker and two callbacks; the demo feeds it Newick written from our TreeModel and reaches camera, colours and settings through React fiber props of its inner Deck component.

applied: canvas background --bg1 as the CSS background of our host element (the deck.gl canvas is transparent); dark: gbifDarkTheme() background
branch colour --fg2 (dark: --fg3) through the library's own settings.setLineColor, reached via React fiber props of the inner Deck (not a public prop); one colour for all branches
tip label colour --fg1 through settings.setTerminalNodeLabelColor (same route)

tip dot colour --fg2 by giving every tip a unique key (TSV column) and pushing a key-to-RGB map into the library's colour state (setAdditionalColorMapping, same fiber route); clade colours from the shell's categorical palette use the same map
tip dot size and opacity (1) through settings.setNodeSize / setOpacity; Library option for the size
tip links: real a[href] overlay in --font-body italic, colours --fg1 on --bg1 (HTML, so full CSS control), only where rows are at least 8 px tall
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) mapped onto host background, label colour, line colour and tip colour; highlight and font only for the DOM link overlay
customisation by hiding features: side panel hidden with the official prop sidePanelHiddenByDefault; minimap is a toggle (settings.toggleMinimapEnabled)
not_possible: label font: TextLayer fontFamily is hard-coded 'Roboto, sans-serif' in useLayers.tsx (Rubik cannot be used for WebGL labels; the DOM link overlay uses Rubik italic)
italic scientific names in the WebGL labels: only family name and weight are in the layer spec
highlight colour: search rings take colours from a fixed list (red, blue, green, magenta, cyan, yellow) in useSearch.tsx; --color-primary cannot be used
selection ring and hover ring: fixed black rings in useLayers.tsx; they are invisible on a dark background
branch colour per clade: all lines share one colour (settings.lineColor); clade colouring only reaches the tip dots

the library's own chrome: zoom buttons, camera/settings buttons, Taxonium link, minimap frame, hover tooltip (serif page font and fixed #e5e7eb grey), side-panel strip are white/grey Tailwind UI with hard-coded colours and do not follow tokens or dark mode

colour legend (Key): lists 10 arbitrary tip keys because our colouring uses one key per tip; no prop disables it, so it is hidden with a CSS selector (div:has(> .key-text)). That is CSS hiding of library UI, not an official option
dark theme for tooltip, minimap and buttons: none of them react to prefers-color-scheme or props
CSS variables and prefers-color-scheme: none; everything on the canvas is set through settings setters that only exist as React state inside the component
styling.notes: DEMO ONLY, GPL-3.0, not for shipping. Styling reaches the canvas only through settings setters and a colour map that are internal React state of taxonium-component 2.1.24; the adapter finds them through React fiber props (fragile across releases, but verified to work on this version). Tailwind CSS of the library is injected globally by the package (scoped under .taxonium). With the colour-by key trick the dots of 1,000 tips at the fit view are hidden by their own 1 px outlines (the library draws outlines for fewer than 3,000 nodes), so clade colour is only visible when zoomed in or on larger trees.
